name: Word of Grievous Healing, Mass
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 6, inquisitor 5, shaman 5, witch 6

This spell functions like cure light wounds except that it cures 5d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +25).
